title: Check the On the Road 65Plus guide
summary: Find safety tips and advice for people aged 65 or over regarding driving, riding, walking, using a mobility scooter, or using public transport.
intro:
The 'On the Road 65Plus' guide has advice and safety tips to help people aged 65 years or over make safer choices when driving, riding, walking, using a mobility scooter or catching public transport.

The guide explains the NSW older driver licensing system and includes information for those who want to transition from full-time driving to other transport options.

The guide covers topics including:

how_to_steps.text: Download the On the Road 65Plus guide in PDF format.
Pick up a copy at a Service NSW Service Centre.
Read information online at The Road Ahead.
